subject.title: fix(feishu): retry once on token-invalid errors 99991663/99991664 with cache invalidation (fixes #97287)

question: Should this PR become the canonical Feishu invalid-token recovery branch after current-head proof, or should maintainers choose one of the sibling implementations for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97287?
rationale: The code path is plausible, but several open PRs implement the same auth/message-delivery behavior and the registered cache-clearing scope needs Feishu owner acceptance before merge.

options.title: Use this branch after proof
options.body: Require redacted current-head proof for 99991663/99991664 recovery, then treat this branch as canonical if the cache scope is acceptable.

options.title: Choose a sibling branch
options.body: Select another open Feishu invalid-token PR if maintainers prefer its smaller diff or account-scoped refresh shape, then close this PR as superseded after preserving useful context.

options.title: Pause for owner design
options.body: Hold all candidate branches if Feishu owners want a different token-cache ownership design before retry behavior lands.

recommendation.title: Use this branch after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted current-head proof for 99991663/99991664 recovery, then treat this branch as canonical if the cache scope is acceptable.
